programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey Preps the bed of the NAPA Perfect additions truck. From rolling out Herculiner to installing transfer tank, truck boxes, and even a combination generator/compressor, this big Ford begins its Perfect Additions transformation. He also throws in a wiring tech that will keep you from getting your wires crossed.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey tackles power gains at the air intake, modifies the computer and replaces the stock exhaust before addressing a 2” front-end suspension lift kit. He moves on to give the truck some extra height and support in the rear of the truck where payload weight can be a serious issue. After the suspension is in place, new wheels and tires bring the truck back down to the ground. Stacey also covers several tools that will help you get that old exhaust out from under your vehicle.

programme.title: The Ed Sullivan Show
programme.desc: "The Ed Sullivan Show" is TV's longest-running variety show. It ran on Sunday nights for an amazing 23 years. The show's host, Ed Sullivan, had been a syndicated newspaper columnist who hosted two radio shows before agreeing to try television. On camera, Sullivan always seemed nervous and ill at ease; he couldn't sing or dance, but he knew people who could and signed them to appear each week. Called "Toast of the Town" until 1955, "The Ed Sullivan Show" featured the TV debuts of artists such as Irving Berlin, Hedy Lamarr, Walt Disney, and Fred Astaire and Jane Powell. The format of the show changed very little over the years, with Sullivan presenting acts that tried to please everyone. A typical show might include a few comics, an aria performed by an opera diva, an acrobat and maybe a plug for a new film from a well-known movie star.

programme.desc: "The Ed Sullivan Show" is TV's longest-running variety show. It ran on Sunday nights for an amazing 23 years. The show's host, Ed Sullivan, had been a syndicated newspaper columnist who hosted two radio shows before agreeing to try television. On camera, Sullivan always seemed nervous and ill at ease; he couldn't sing or dance, but he knew people who could and signed them to appear each week. Called "Toast of the Town" until 1955, "The Ed Sullivan Show" featured the TV debuts of artists such as Irving Berlin, Hedy Lamarr, Walt Disney, and Fred Astaire and Jane Powell. The format of the show changed very little over the years, with Sullivan presenting acts that tried to please everyone. A typical show might include a few comics, an aria performed by an opera diva, an acrobat and maybe a plug for a new film from a well-known movie star.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Gareth y su grupo de caníbales atacan la iglesia mientras Rick y sus compañeros están en el bosque buscándolos para vengar a Bob. Además, el padre Gabriel confiesa el siniestro acto de su pasado que no deja descansar a su conciencia.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Beth se despierta en un hospital de Atlanta, pero pronto se da cuenta de que los mismos que la auxiliaron y sanaron no la dejarán marchar. No obstante, su nuevo amigo, Noah, y ella tratan de huir del recinto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras se dirigen hacia el norte, el grupo se ve obligado a detenerse porque una horda de zombis bloquea el camino. La tensión aumenta y la situación termina por estallar cuando Eugene confiesa un secreto que había ocultado a todos hasta ahora.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol y Daryl persiguen a los captores de Beth por una Atlanta devastada, pero su auto se queda sin gasolina y deben pasar la noche en un refugio para mujeres.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick busca una salida pacífica al conflicto, pero sus enemigos la rechazan y prefieren zanjar las cosas de forma violenta.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.sub-title: Lo que pasó y lo que está sucediendo
programme.desc: Para cumplir con la promesa que Beth le hizo Noah antes de morir, el grupo se dirige al barrio de Noah, esperando hallar allí protección y a otros supervivientes. Sin embargo, Rick y los suyos no quieren hacerse demasiadas esperanzas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El vehículo se avería y el grupo continúa a pie hacia Washington D. C., pero les sorprende una tormenta y buscan cobijo en un granero, donde encuentran algo totalmente inesperado e inquietante.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E07 - Cornwall NB
programme.desc: In this episode, Marilia explores various locations in Cornwall. She visits Boscastle, known for its witch stories, and enjoys ocean views from a field. She also explores Merlin's Cave and meets a life coach named Euan in St Neot. Marilia engages in nature bathing and encounters wildlife while walking towards Muir. At Joe's home and studio, she assists him in painting and enjoys his vinyl covers and guitar music. Marilia learns about animal massage therapy from Jenna and goes on a carriage ride through rural scenery. She joins the Seaweeders for seaweed foraging, visits the drying warehouse, and meets Gemma, an Alexander Technique specialist. Marilia also takes time to relax at a hotel spa, filming her show against the stunning ocean cliff. This episode offers a captivating exploration of Cornwall's landscapes, encounters with talented individuals, and immersive experiences.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E08 - St. Pete NB
programme.desc: Marilia embarks on a captivating journey, capturing the essence of Treasure Island through extraordinary encounters. They film hidden treasures and enchanting allure against stunning backdrops. At Fort DeSoto, Marilia embraces the tranquil beauty of the beach, while Ashley leads them to Boyd Hill National Park for profound conversations beneath a magnificent tree. In Ashley's studio, a tea ceremony symbolizes tranquility and connection, followed by an intimate interview unveiling her artistry. Gulfport Beach becomes a sanctuary for transformative sound healing, and Marilia rides a bike along the boardwalk, capturing the synergy between nature and human activity. Marilia meets Justin, capturing his unique vision and creativity, and encounters Lindy, a captivating sound healer. Dolphin Yoga at CMA merges Marilia's practice with the playful marine world, while Levi guides her through an extraordinary dolphin feeding session. Clearwater Marine Aquarium showcases the dedication of the staff and educates visitors about marine conservation. In Irene's studio, Marilia explores the wellness aspect of Flamenco dance. The journey concludes at Mirror Lake, encapsulating the profound impact of Marilia's experiences through heartfelt testimonials and reflective voice-overs.

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.sub-title: Camping on the Ferry to Alaska
programme.desc: Our journey starts in the Pacific Northwest as we prepare to head up to Alaska on the Alaskan Marine Highway. Our passage on the Alaska Marine Highway left from the port in Bellingham Washington and would soon carry us nearly a 1000 miles north, to Juneau Alaska. The boat navigates an intricate path through the inside passage which is a narrow network of corridors through the islands on the Pacific Northwest coast of the North American Fjordlands.

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.desc: Our first official stop in Alaska: Juneau! Neither of us were ready for how smitten we'd become with the capitol of Alaska. In our first few days in Juneau we explore multiple glaciers, meet and hike with a few locals, try some local food and beer, all while having the most breathtaking camp views we've ever had.

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.sub-title: Ice Caves and Ice Climbing in Alaska
programme.desc: Still in Juneau Alaska we head out to Mendenhall Glacier or Aak'wtaaksit, to the native Tlingit people which translates to the Glacier Behind the Little Lake. We spend an entire day exploring and ice climbing with some new friends. After getting to know the glacier we head back out for one last adventure into the the ice before boarding the ferry to our next destination.

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.sub-title: Driving the ALCAN From Haines to Fairbanks
programme.desc: After leaving Juneau we take the Alaska Marine Highway to the coastal town of Haines. There we enjoy a few days of exploring before making an attempt to cross the closed US and Canadian Border to get to the interior of Alaska.

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.sub-title: The Great One - Denali National Park
programme.desc: After leaving Fairbanks we head south to the town of Healy in preparation for some time in Denali National Park & Preserve. We take the bus to Wonder Lake campground where we patiently wait to get a glimpse of the tallest mountain in North America.

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.desc: We spend our last day in Denali National Park before relocating to the charming town of Talkeetna. While in Talkeetna we meet the Mayor, hike to try to get another view of Denali, and catch a glimpse of our first ever salmon run!

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.sub-title: Incredible Hiking in Hatcher Pass Alaska
programme.desc: After leaving Talkeetna we head to the long awaited Hatcher Pass. Neither one of us was ready for the rugged beauty of this area after nearly a month of Boreal Forests. We spend our time in the area hiking to turquoise lakes and make a surprise stop to fish after seeing them rise on a passing lake!

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.sub-title: The Fishing Bears of Katmai National Park
programme.desc: This episode was life changing for us. We visit Katmai National Park and Preserve to visit the fishing bears of Brooks Falls. A place that has captivated us since we were kids. After a short flight and a float plane we arrive at the most incredible place we've ever visited.

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.desc: When we returned from Katmai National Park we venture onto the Kenai Peninsula for the first time in our travels in Alaska. We stop in the town of Whittier before heading to Homer, Alaska. While in Homer we meet up with some new friends for a trip across the inlet to see icebergs and incredible wildlife. We also find some ocean side camping that ends up being our favorite in all of Alaska.

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.desc: In this episode we head to Seward, Alaska. A charming coastal town where we explore the glaciers and ice fields of Kenia Fjords National Park and take to the water to try to get out to a tide water glacier.

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.sub-title: Dropped in the Wilderness of Alaska
programme.desc: There's a first for everything. In this installment of Lost & Found, we get dropped off by a float plane in the backcountry of the Kenai Wilderness for a few days of exploring!

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.sub-title: Surfing the Longest Wave in Alaska
programme.desc: In this episode, MAK heads out into the water of the Turnagain arm to try to surf the rare Bore Tide wave before heading back to Whittier to take to the water!

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.desc: The day after our glacier boat tour we find an incredible scene as the salmon are running up a near by river before heading off the Kenai Peninsula for the last time. We then head into the fascinating town of McCarthy, Alaska and Wrangell-St. Elias National Park. From there we explore Root Glacier and the Kennicott mining operation.

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.desc: We venture back out onto Root Glacier to complete our goal of doing a polar plunge. Then we start the long journey towards the US and Canadian Border and stop to explore a road that wanders along side a glacier to find a camp spot for the night.

programme.title: Adventure Cities

While the region is best known for its proximity to Yellowstone National Park, Jonathan sets out to discover what lies beyond the typical tourist trail—uncovering the unexpected adventures, outdoor experiences, and local character that makes Cody Yellowstone a true adventure destination.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 40: Dudas, Secretos y Cartas de Amor
programme.desc: En su enfrentamiento de hombre a hombre con Jes s, Gabriel se ve impedido a disimular la duda que lo agobia en cuanto a la vida marital de Marisela al darse cuenta de que la pareja se mantiene conviviendo en camas separadas, Jes s busca una excusa cre ble para hacer que las dudas de Gabriel se evadan y este quede satisfecho con su explicaci n acerca de la felicidad que sienten Marisela y el al haberse convertido en un matrimonio. Marisela alerta a Bertica de la llegada de Ricardo dej ndose llevar por la angustia de que su hijo y Gabriel se encuentren al sentir la culpa de haber mantenido oculto su vinculo como padre e hijo. En el s tano Aurora se deja invadir por la curiosidad al encontrar unas antiguas cartas de amor.

programme.title: Episodio 83: Dudas, celos y culpa navideña.
programme.desc: Estando en su casa, Tatiana le pregunta a Doroteo que si durmió con la mamá, y se arma una discusión entre ellas, En la casa de Gladys se preparan para la navidad, arreglando y decorando, ella se da cuenta de que Dileydis esta como triste y le pregunta que si es por el hombre ese, ella le dice que ¡no! que ya se le va a pasar. Gladys les da consejos de cómo ser feliz y le dice que tiene que echar para adelante y olvidarse de él. Igualmente Eglee, habla con Luis Fernando diciéndole que tiene que ser feliz y no estar sufriendo, el le dice que está bien y que también se le va pasar. Rómulo y Betzaida acaban de llegar de su luna de miel, ella esta algo enojada porque se vinieron antes por culpa de Eglee, el le promete que planearán otra salida y que la complacerá en todo para serla feliz. Pascuita llama a Gonzalo para hablar en su casa el tema de salvar su matrimonio con Matilde, mientras que Matilde y Monchito están de compras navideñas, casualmente se consiguen y compran el mismo regalo para sus parejas un ¡maletín!, Pascuita continua hablando con Gonzalo y le hace varias propuestas para que sean felices los dos, entre ellas esta la idea de casarse y tener una segunda luna miel. Felicita llega a la casa de Luis Fernando para hablar con el, le dice que esta feliz de que esté con María gracia, él le contesta que ella también fue muy importante cuando estaban saliendo, se va y se encuentra a Tatiana y le dice lo mismo, que ella es una mujer espectacular, bella y atractiva. Estando en el carro se encuentra a Maria Gracia y le dice igualmente que ella es muy importante para él, se va y se pone a pensar de que le sirve tener tanta muchacha bella si está amargado extrañando a Dileydis. Dileydis y Luis Fernando se poner a pensar en su relación y en que fue que fallaron, en el fondo se mueren de ganas de esta juntos. En casa de Eglee están reunidas Cristinita, Maria Gracia, Tatiana y Felicita, estas dos hablan un poco envidiosas sobre la relación de Maria Gracia y Luis Fernando diciendo que no es nada serio y simplemente ella es un resuelve. Eglee habla con Gladys sobre la sorpresiva llegada de Rómulo, sintiéndose culpable de su interrupción en la luna de miel. Betzaida, Matilde, Pascuita y la nena se ponen a pensar en sus relaciones personales y a sentirse culpable de su situación en pareja. Luis Fernando también siente sentimiento de culpa por Dileidys, Santiago le dice que se tiene que concentrar en el trabajo y olvidarse de eso, Luis Fernando piensa en quien pudo ser la persona involucrada en el cambio de Dileydis hacia él y llegan a la conclusión de que Maria Gracia tiene algo que ver. Dileydis y Yenilú conversan de la situación de su relación y del porque el cambio de Luis Fernando, llegando a la conclusión de que a él no le gustan las mujeres pobres. Luis Fernando sigue conversando con Santiago y se niega a pensar que Maria Gracia haya sido la culpable de que Dileydis haya cambiado con él, Santiago le dice que ella conocía la relación que tenia con ella y que deje de dudarlo ya que es quien armó el problema para separarlos. Rómulo y Betzaida llegan a trabajar a la oficina y todos se quedan asombrados por su corta luna de miel, sobretodo Eglee quien se burla de él alegando que sigue siendo el mismo hombre aburrido de siempre. La Nena llega a casa de una de sus alumnas y se enoja porque no se encuentra, cree que la pava se le ha vendido encima porque todas las cosas malas la persiguen y que no tiene fuerza de voluntad para sacarse de la cabeza a Doroteo. En el negocio de Gabito, Doroteo habla de su relación con la Nena alegando que ella lo quiere y que ya se olvidó de su antiguo esposo, el difunto. En la oficina Betzaida y Eglee se ponen a discutir en su mente sobre Rómulo y a tirarse puntas, en ese momento llega un ramo de flores y el señor pregunta que si se encuentra la señora de garcía, y responden las dos ¡soy yo! sin saber realmente a quien va dirigido.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 28: El Viaje de Reinaldo y Venganza de Michelle
programme.desc: En el aeropuerto Reinaldo inicia su viaje hacia una nueva vida convertido en otra persona. Inés y Luis Guillermo recuerdan a Reinaldo quien los sorprendió con su repentina muerte Jean Paul los interrumpe informándolos acerca de lo acontecido por Michelle en la disquera. Michelle tras haber sido echada por Diego Andrés desquita su ira con Marisela quien es la víctima inocente de su odio, Bertha aprovechándose de la situación maltrata a Marisela quien se ve a merced de todas sus maldades. Armando percatado de la situación entre Michelle y Diego Andrés le exige a este casarse con su hija amenazándolo con llevarlo a la cárcel por haber estado involucrado con una menor, Diego Andrés intenta defenderse del ataque de Armando al confesarle sus sentimientos.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Abril va a llevarle el bebé a Vicenta y llevarse con ella a Alejandrito; pero Abril, junto a Ángel, llegan cuando Federico y Vicenta están discutiendo, entonces, Federico, le dice a Abril que se lleve a ese bebé, porque no es su hijo, porque él es estéril. Abril se lleva al niño y lo cuidan junto con Karelis. Vicenta, se va a la casa de unos tíos, hasta que resuelva la situación con Federico. Pero Federico se altera, y tiene una discusión muy fuerte con Vicenta donde le dice que es una mentirosa y farsante, y que seguramente, ese bebé es hijo de Christian, porque ellos estaban casados y seguramente, se acostó con él. Federico tira cosas y Vicenta se va de la casa.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 40: Socorro Reclama, Karen y Salvador se Casan
programme.desc: Socorro sigue impactada por el beso que vio entre Karen y Salvador. Karen, amorosa con “su novio”, le cuenta a Socorro que se casará con Salvador. Socorro se aleja sorprendida. Cuando llega a su casa, Salvador se encuentra de nuevo con Socorro, quien le reclama con vehemencia esperando que él le cuente la historia que ha tenido con Karen. entra a su exsuegra Sara en un hospital siquiátrico, pero la mujer está tan enferma que no hace caso a ninguna de las preguntas que Josefina le hace.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 36: Ricardo y Gabriel Unidos por Jesus
programme.desc: Cuando Arelys presiona a Marisela para que le diga si realmente como ella sospecha Gabriel es el padre de su hijo ella lo niega y promete disculparse con Gabriel por la forma en que lo trató. Gabriel reza y pide a Dios para que le ayude a que Jesús tenga una enfermedad más llevadera, sin saber que a sus espaldas Ricardo hace lo mismo y demuestra de alguna forma con gestos el lazo que los une, cosa que también nota Napoleón cuando viene a buscar a Ricardo. El Gavilán sigue haciendo monerías para que Abril deje de llorar y se enfrenta a los demás conductores cuando intentan que se quite de la vía y Abril de alguna forma también trata de protegerlo.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 37: Advertencias, Seduccion y Acusaciones de Infidelidad
programme.desc: En la clínica Aurora intenta advertir a Marisela de lo que acontece con Ricardo y Gabriela viéndose obligada a silenciar su advertencia en vista de lo ocurre con la grave enfermedad de Jesús esperando no convertirse ella y su información en un motivo para causar una nueva preocupación en la sufrida muchacha. Isadora seduce a Gabriel quien sintiéndose torturado por el rechazo de Marisela la acepta el amor de Isadora sin ningún reparo. En la clínica, a pesar de sus esfuerzos y su dedicación hacia Jesús Marisela es victima de las acusaciones de su esposo quien insiste en tacharla de infiel en vista de su romance del pasado con Gabriel Reyes

programme.title: Episodio 38: Rechazo, un secreto desenmascarado y un juramento.
programme.desc: En la clínica Marisela se ve sorprendida debido a la decisión de Jesús, quien insiste en rechazarla hasta llegar al punto de pedirle el divorcio debido a su postrante enfermedad, Jesús descarga toda su agresividad en contra de Marisela sintiéndose culpable por haberla amarrado a el a largos años de sufrimiento. A su llegada a la clínica, Isadora toma la decisión de desenmascarar la mentira de Ricardo al dejarse llevar por su presentimiento y descubrir al verdadero padre de Ricardo. A pesar del rechazo y las crueles palabras de Jesús Marisela se hace el juramento de jamás abandonar al desvalido hombre. A su llegada al apartamento de Candelaria, Abril es recibida afectuosamente por Gavilán.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 39: Candela echa a Abril de casa
programme.desc: Candela discute con Abril quien desesperada intenta hacerla recordar d ndole referencias acerca del hijo que le entrego a os atr s, Candela haciendo caso omiso de la desesperaci n de Abril echa a la muchacha de su casa al creerla una polic a. A su salida de la casa de Candelaria, Abril se encuentra nuevamente con Gavil n dej ndose llevar por la incertidumbre de conocer mas acerca de la vida del joven muchacho que la embarga de tanta dulzura. En la universidad el doctor Ra l imparte su estricta c tedra bajo la protesta de sus j venes disc pulos, Giancarlos se encarga de encomendarle a sus c mplices y colaboradores la puesta en marcha del plan en contra de Ricardo y Gabriela.

programme.title: Episodio 24: Luis y la aparici n de Emperatriz
programme.desc: Luis habla con In s acerca de su decisi n de irse de la casa y se da cuenta que no puede hacerlo por su familia. Marisela llega llorando al jard n para hablar con Che to, pero ste no la entiende y sale corriendo. D bora invita a Luis a la fiesta de Walter. Berta pregunta por Emperatriz y Campuzano le dice que la vio con Marisela en la avenida. In s y Asunta se sorprenden de ver a Emperatriz en la casa de los Nu ez. Emperatriz empieza hablar cosas sin sentido e In s le ofrece un te. Flavia se presenta en la oficina de Armando y se lo lleva a comer a un restaurante rom ntico. Armando trata de justificar una llamada de Solbella diciendo que es por el negocio.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 25: El Secreto de la Foto Perdida
programme.desc: Daniela llega al local nocturno para la fiesta de Walter y está nerviosa esperando que llegue Luis, por fin llega en compañía de Inés a quien Walter saluda muy cordialmente. Flavia le reclama a Berta la forma humillante que trató a Marisela, pero Berta se defiende y le dice que en casa a normas que hay que cumplir y si no lo hace se tiene que ir,. Flavia trata de explicarle a Armando la forma tan cruel que Berta ha castigado a Marisela. Flavia con Brígida tratan de calmar a Marisela para que pueda comer, quien poco a poco intenta hacerlo. Marisela a explica a Flavia porque Berta se enojó tanto con ella y le detalla lo sucedido con Emperatriz quien tenía una foto del padre de Reinaldo Núñez y ella la llevó a esa casa.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 26: Disparo de Daniela contra Ines
programme.desc: Inés y Luis Guillermo regresan de la fiesta de Walter, mientras tanto Daniela llega borracha a su casa con Robert y luego se mete al cuarto de Ines y le reclama el haber estado con Luis guillermo en la fiesta cuando ella le había indicado el no acercarcele, le apunta con una pistola, y le dispara, entonces Luis Guillermo y Diego Andrés, al oir el disparo corren a ver que pasó.Gabriela y Victoria les informan lo sucedido. Diego Andrés le comenta a Daniela la suerte que tuvo pues el disparo dio fue exactamente en la pared. Luis Guillermo comenta el que Daniela esta vez fue demasiado lejos. Y pienza que nunca imaginó que Daniela iba a cometer esa locura, a lo que Asunta le dice a Luis Guillermo que debería denunciar por el intento de asesinato.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 27: Michelle Amenaza con Quitarse la Vida
programme.desc: Michelle desde la azotea del edificio, amenaza con tirarse al vacio, en eso Armando. Bertha, y Flavia tratan de convencerla para que no lo haga. Flavia llama a Diego para decirle lo que está sucediendo con Mitchelle, luego este se traslada al sitio y trata de convencer a Mitchellec que desista de su intencion.. Diego logra retener a Mitchelle pero Armando se la arrebata de sus manos y se aleja con ella..Diego llama a casa de Mitchelle para saber sobre su estado cuando el médico le está examinando, a lo cual concluye que fue sometida auna gran presión pero que ya se está estabilizando y le ordena su tratamiento.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 28: El Viaje de Reinaldo y Venganza de Michelle
programme.desc: En el aeropuerto Reinaldo inicia su viaje hacia una nueva vida convertido en otra persona. Inés y Luis Guillermo recuerdan a Reinaldo quien los sorprendió con su repentina muerte Jean Paul los interrumpe informándolos acerca de lo acontecido por Michelle en la disquera. Michelle tras haber sido echada por Diego Andrés desquita su ira con Marisela quien es la víctima inocente de su odio, Bertha aprovechándose de la situación maltrata a Marisela quien se ve a merced de todas sus maldades. Armando percatado de la situación entre Michelle y Diego Andrés le exige a este casarse con su hija amenazándolo con llevarlo a la cárcel por haber estado involucrado con una menor, Diego Andrés intenta defenderse del ataque de Armando al confesarle sus sentimientos.

programme.desc: Lo más importante en el mercado mundial del arte es si es auténtico o falso. Cuando una falsificación se hace pasar por real, se pueden ganar y perder fortunas. Fue uno de los mayores fraudes en el mundo del arte. ¿Cómo se salieron con la suya durante tanto tiempo?

programme.title: La Ruta Blanca
programme.desc: Francisca Rojas planea retirarse del negocio cocalero, pero encuentra una serpiente en su último pedido. En México, el actor Alejandro Sandoval sufre un atentado mientras Homero Paz aborda su avión privado. En Bogotá, el político Esteban Mejía coquetea con un joven. Dos años antes, la guerrilla ataca a Francisca, quien huye con su hijo y hermano tras la muerte de su esposo.

programme.title: La Ruta Blanca
programme.desc: Mauricio lucha con el matrimonio de Esteban y Alicia, mientras Esteban finge ante la sociedad. La casa de Roberto y Adelfa es incendiada y ellos desaparecen. En Bogotá, Esteban no sube en las encuestas pese a su matrimonio, lo que Alberto y “el jefe” aprovechan para aliarse con él.

programme.title: La Ruta Blanca
programme.desc: Alias “Caleto” le segura a Francisca que Roberto y Adelfa fueron expulsados de la zona por incumplir con los acuerdos pactados. Por otra parte “el jefe” no tiene éxito en su intento de aliarse con Esteban, razón por la cual pone en marcha un plan de persecución y hostigamiento en contra del político. Más adelante Francisca halla los cuerpos sin vida de Roberto y Adelfa.

programme.title: La Ruta Blanca
programme.desc: Francisca asesina a Caleto tras confesar que Libardo ordenó matar a Roberto y Adelfa. Un video compromete a Esteban políticamente. En Miami, Alejandro Sandoval se adentra en el consumo de cocaína con Sara Mendoza. Francisca se reencuentra con el asesino de Vicente. Esteban y Alberto son secuestrados tras visitar a Mauricio, quien fue brutalmente golpeado.

programme.title: La Ruta Blanca
programme.desc: Ambrosio encuentra el cuerpo de Lucía y, tras enfrentarse a Homero, acepta irse a EE.UU. Esteban es amenazado por “el jefe” con divulgar un video íntimo. Alejandro recibe la noticia del embarazo de Lourdes. Esteban acepta la ayuda de “el jefe” y cambia su postura sobre el narcotráfico. Ambrosio se alía con Pedro y Homero propone negocios al señor Mastreta.

programme.title: La Ruta Blanca
programme.desc: Homero cierra un trato con Mastreta para pasar droga por el aeropuerto de México. Domingo llega al campamento guerrillero y es retenido por Patiño. Mauricio renuncia tras las nuevas declaraciones de Esteban sobre el narcotráfico. Pedro se entera de la traición de Homero. Esmeralda contrata un detective para investigar a su esposo.

programme.title: Parejas Criminales
programme.desc: Mario contrata a un director estrella para rodar un nuevo comercial para su bufete de abogados. Mientras tanto, Karen descubre que conducir en Staten Island es un poco diferente que conducir en los suburbios.

programme.title: Fugitivos
programme.desc: Camila descubre la infidelidad de su esposo en Hidrosferas, pero es asesinada antes de poder confrontarlo. Julián, el esposo, es acusado injustamente del crimen. Mariana, su esposa, lo da por muerto. En prisión, Julián conoce a Esperanza, otra víctima de la justicia, y juntos planean su escape.

programme.title: Fugitivos
programme.desc: Sierra, obsesionado con Esperanza, intenta separarla de Julián. Ricardo manipula a Mariana y a Julián para evitar su contacto. El rumor de una fuga se esparce en la cárcel, atrayendo a los reclusos más peligrosos. Sin embargo, todos ignoran que Sierra está al tanto y espera el momento perfecto para actuar.

programme.title: Fugitivos
programme.desc: Sierra borra toda evidencia de su implicación en la fuga, pero Esperanza lo acusa durante un interrogatorio. Los directivos deben decidir a quién creer. Julián, ahora libre, busca aliados para esconderse y probar su inocencia. En honor a Esperanza, Julián busca a su hija para reunirla con su madre.

programme.title: Fugitivos
programme.desc: Micaela, tras robar un artículo valioso, es perseguida por un corrupto policía de la DLA que busca eliminar cualquier rastro de sus transacciones. Julián intenta protegerla, pero su actitud soberbia lo dificulta. En prisión, una nueva amiga ayuda a Esperanza a mejorar su vida y la anima a mantener la esperanza de reunirse con su hija.

programme.title: Fugitivos
programme.desc: Esperanza, preocupada por Julián y su hija, envía a Cancan a buscar información, confirmando la desaparición de su hija. Mariana lucha por encontrar trabajo debido a su falta de experiencia. Mientras tanto, Julián y Micaela huyen de la ciudad y del hotel donde se escondían, pero Steve Houston decide culpar a Micaela de sus propios crímenes.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Mount Washington, New Hampshire has the dubious title of being home to the world’s worst weather. The highest wind ever recorded on the planet – 231 miles per hour – was recorded at its mountaintop observatory. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council’s high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.

programme.desc: The kids gather in the park for an exciting tea party they had planned, which begins with each of them showing each other the various ways they've contributed, from cookies to decorations. As the day progresses, the tea party proves to be a fun opportunity to reinforce lessons about good manners!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Mr. Boyd wanders around the park searching for his dog Bingo, who playfully hides in different areas of the park. Barney and the kids help find Bingo, and subsequently help Mr. Boyd prepare Bingo for a trip to the veterinarian for a checkup. This eventful day gives the kids an opportunity to learn lessons about how to care for a dog.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney and his friends are so excited for a day of play and fun! When a bunch of empty boxes arrived from the Enjoy-Your-Toys Company, their adventure begins. They use their imagination to have the best time ever by transforming the boxes into special toys.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: After playing with Stop and Go signs with Angela, Baby Bop leaves to direct some traffic of her own. Barney and his friends think of other ways to stop and go and discuss reading, especially traffic signs!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney helps his friends put together a Caboose Color Collection which showcases the primary colorsred, yellow and blue. This activity sparks Barney and the kids' imagination, and along with Baby Bop, they realize just how colorful the world can be!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: The children are amazed to find out that playing games and having fun in the park is a great way to exercise. When the rain starts to fall, they use their imagination to come up with clever ways to stay active and have fun indoors.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney and the kids are full of excitement as five of Mr. Boyd's brass-playing friends are planning a special show in the park tonight! Angela is determined to learn the trumpet, but she finds it challenging. To help them get ready for the band's practice, Mr. Boyd introduces the children to various types of horns, making it a fun learning experience!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Meet Colleen, Mr. Boyd's niece! Barney and the kids love having fun together every day but making a brand NEW friend is something extra special! With Barney's help, they all learn how to get to know new friends.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Everyone is excited for Halloween tonight! Everyone knows what they're going to be for Halloween. BJ is going to be a pirate, Melanie is going to be a cat, David will be a superhero, and Baby Bop is going to be a ballerina princess. Everyone has decided on a costume all except for Riff. Barney tries to give Riff ideas on a costume like a sailor, a firefighter, or a dancer. Riff surprises everyone in the end by wearing a one-man band costume. Then, it's time for the Halloween party to begin! Barney and his friends have fun Trick-or-Treating in the park at night. But when Ramon loses all his Halloween candies, BJ shares his Halloween candies with him.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ feels left out when the kids have a Dog Show to show off their pets. BJ doesn't have a dog and wishes he did! A friend shares her dog with BJ so he can join in the fun. Barney's friends are having a hard time deciding what to do because everyone wants to do the same thing! Barney's Native American tale, The Chase, shows them that it's best to think for themselves and not follow the crowd.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: Dream Big - Thats What A Mommy Is
programme.desc: After watching birds fly overhead, Riff begins to daydream of flying. He decides to build his very own rocket ship and fly to Mars. The flight is not exactly a success, but Barney encourages Riff to never give up on his dream. After seeing many moms playing with their kids in the park, Baby Bop is curious as to what makes somebody a mommy. With Barney's help, Baby Bop learns all about what makes mommies so special.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop's blankey seems to be getting smaller; she's convinced it's shrinking. But Barney shows her that, actually, Baby Bop is growing. When Riff takes a bite of ice cream, he realizes has a very sore tooth. Afraid of going to the dentist, Barney and his friends put on a show to help Riff see there is nothing to be afraid of - the dentist is his friend.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Marcos accidentally breaks an art show project that Melanie has made. Afraid that she will be angry, he doesn't say anything, but then feels guilty. Barney helps him see that honesty is the best policy. Meanwhile, Myra, has decided she doesn't like her name. After learning about many names and what they mean, Barney helps Myra see how special her name truly is.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: The Magic Caboose - BJ the Great
programme.desc: Melanie is sad because she misses her friend, Marisa who is visiting relatives in India. Barney takes her and the other kids on a trip to the magic caboose to visit pretend countries like Egypt, Tahiti, and India. When they were in a pretend country of India, they saw a real elephant and in the end, Melanie gets a email from her friend in India (who has also seen a real elephant in India!). BJ wants to be a great magician, but he doesn't want to spend any time practicing. He convinces Baby Bop to help him do a trick, and makes her disappear. When BJ thought she is gone forever, he realizes the importance of practice. Luckily, Baby Bop hasn't disappeared after all!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: Gift of the Dinos - A Visit to Santa
programme.desc: Barney and his friends are decorating the caboose for Christmas when Barney decides to plan a Secret Santa game. Everyone has to buy or make a gift for the friend whose name they have drawn. Melanie misses the mailman, so Barney takes her to Santa's workshop at the North Pole to deliver her wish list in person.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: Riff's Musical Zoo - The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: Riff decides to create a musical zoo when their zoo trip is postponed. Gathering instruments that sound like real animals, Riff gives Barney and his friends a zoo-mazing experience. When Baby Bop hesitates on keeping her promise to watch Ryan's pet frog, Barney tells her the story of The Frog Prince. And Baby Bop learns about keeping her promises.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: Way to Go! - A Travel Adventure
programme.desc: When Baby Bop finds out that Daniel is going on a trip the next day, she wants to go on a trip as well. Everyone decides to pretend to travel the same way Daniel will travel. First, they all make cardboard cars out of some scrap boxes. Next, everyone pretends to be an airplane. Then Barney turns the cardboard airplanes into a great big cardboard bus. They go on a camera safari only to discover the last mode of their transportation--a big cardboard cruise ship.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: The Misbegotten Moon - A Space Adventure
programme.desc: After noticing parts of the moon are missing in the night sky, Baby Bop is determined to find the rest of it. It's up to Barney and the kids to help Baby Bop take a trip to outer space where they meet Mr. Moon. Baby Bop then learns that the moon is not always full at night.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: The Sword in the Sandbox - A Storybook Adventure
programme.desc: Daniel fails miserably when he tries to join the others in jump rope. Convinced that he's too little to do anything right, Barney tells him the story of The Sword in the Sandbox. Through the legend of King Arthur, Daniel learns there are many things he can do... if he tries hard enough.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: Riff to the Rescue! - A Wild West Adventure
programme.desc: When Riff is asked to be captain of a baseball team, he doesnt think he can do it. But Barney gives him the courage to try, by recounting the tale of his great-great-grandfather Riffle the Wild West hero!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: Lights! Camera! Action! - A Movie Adventure
programme.desc: Melanie comes up with the perfect idea to get people to donate to Grace's food drive - put on a movie premiere in the caboose! Barney and friends pitch in to help, but they all have different ideas about what kind of movie to make. Everything they try falls apart. It's curtains for Melanie's movie until she comes up with a blockbuster idea of her own.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: To Catch a Thief - A Mystery Adventure
programme.desc: Detective BJ is on the case when several sports balls suddenly disappear. Determined to find the mysterious ball thief, BJ falsely accuses Riff of being the thief. BJ learns he cannot jump to conclusions and must find the whole story to see who the thief really is.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: The Magic Lamp - A Travel Adventure
programme.desc: Celebrating her birthday in the park with friends, Layla is more interested in hot dogs than her mother's Middle Eastern food. When Barney reads the story of Aladdin and the Magic Lamp, Layla is transported to a Middle Eastern marketplace where she learns different cultures have many exciting foods and customs to offer.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: The Amazing Captain Pickles - A Hero Adventure
programme.desc: Captain Pickles and Wonder Princess both wanted to be the super-est superheroes. When Captain Pickles said he could jump over the moon, everyone wanted to see. BJ knew he couldn't really jump that high, but he could jump high enough to save Emma's balloon. Everyone was proud of him, even if he couldn't jump over the moon. BJ was a hero.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: A Game for Everyone - A Sports Adventure
programme.desc: Barney comes up with the idea to have a sports day in the park. All day, they play games like soccer and hopscotch among others, all for fun. Meanwhile, Baby Bop meets a girl with special needs named Jill, as well as her mom. As Baby Bop gets to know Jill more, she encourages her to play hopscotch with the others. In the end, Baby Bop and Jill win the trophy for hopscotch and she and her mother leave.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: The Reluctant Dragon - A Fairy Tale Adventure
programme.desc: After the kids judge a spider by its creepy looks, Barney tells them the story of The Reluctant Dragon where a shepherd became friends with a dragon, who was judged by her appearance.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop's friend Monty the butterfly passes through the park with a flock of friends on their way to Mexico. When Monty gets left behind, Barney takes everyone on a visit to Mexico to return Monty to his insect friends and family and give Baby Bop the chance to say goodbye to her butterfly friend.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney's excited to find out that Rusty's family is adopting a new baby sister from China; however, Rusty's not sure if he's going to be a good brother, and he doesn't know much about China. Barney shows Rusty and the others some info China on the computer and BJ and Baby Bop talk about siblings. Through Barney's Travel Book, Barney takes Rusty, BJ and Baby Bop on an adventure to China where he can learn more about his new sister's heritage. When they get there, the people are celebrating Chinese New Year. From lion dances and talented performers to tasty treats, making lanterns and puppet shows, the celebration never runs out of fun. By the time he returns to the park, Rusty excitedly meets his new baby sister, named Mei Ling, and realizes he will be the best big brother ever.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Ben is late to the park and is disappointed to realize he missed his chance at riding a real pony. He has waited his whole life for this, and now it looks as if hes missed his opportunity. Luckily, Barney takes Ben to Spain where they meet Regalo, a dancing horse with Riff and Baby Bop. Ben and Barney return to the park just in time for him to ride the pony after all! Ben is thrilled to ride a horse and learned an important lesson about patience and waiting.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Emma is stuck with a school project and can't play soccer with Joshua. Having to interview her parents and get info about an interesting ancestor, she is frustrated with the assignment. Barney helps her discover that her ancestors were from Venice, Italy. Using his Travel Book, Barney takes Joshua, Emma, and Riff to Venice, Italy. He gives his friends a gondola ride as well as telling them about famous explorer Marco Polo. Barney's friend, Anna Maria tells Emma that she knew her great grandfather and takes her to his shop, where they try on masks and make some of their own. Emma learns that if she makes the mask in parts, she'll get it done. Barney reminds her of this lesson, so she will do the same for her school project.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney, Baby Bop, and BJ are helping the kids get ready for a school play. Barney tells everyone that putting on shows began in Greece. Of course, the little dinos and kids want to visit the country, so off they go! While there, they meet some friends and decide to put on a play in an amphitheatre. Barney knows a great story that originated in Greece called King Midas. By the end of the day, everyone has learned that wanting too much is not a good thing, especially BJ!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When Ben accidentally includes Kioko's prized music box from Switzerland in a cardboard box of yard sale items-the music box is sold! Kioko is sad and Ben wants to make things right, so he and Barney travel to Switzerland in search of a replacement gift. While there, they sample Swiss food, customs and games-but no music box! Luckily when Ben returns the music box is returned!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When the kids find a mysterious, colorful egg in the park, Barney takes them on a trip to Kenya to try to find out what kind of animal could have laid the egg. While in Kenya, Barney and the kids meet Ayira who introduces them to many people, cultures, and animals of the country!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: A Bird of a Different Feather
programme.desc: Ben and Rusty are looking for items for superhero costumes, when Barney comes to life, wearing a tutu. Tracy comes in and explains that she needs to find a bird of paradise for a school project. Ben, unsure, tells her they're only found in Hawaii and what they look like. Barney then takes the kids to Hawaii, using his Travel Book. In Hawaii, they learn different words, how to make leis and even a hula dance. Meanwhile, Ben and Rusty search for the bird, with a few close calls (a feather and what ended up being a coconut). During the Luau, it's revealed that the Bird of Paradise is actually a flower, not a bird. Ben, believing that it was a bird earlier, is shocked to hear that and apologizes to Rusty for getting him caught up in things. In the end, it all ends up just fine.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Emma wants to paint an award-winning painting for the Art In The Park Show, but she isn't satisfied with her artwork. Barney takes her to France to learn how to paint from his friend Pierre. While there, they learn about France. And Emma learns how to paint by following her heart!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: It's Earth Day, a great time for everyone to learn how to help take care of our world, but Ben is wasting paper while BJ isn't too concerned about cutting down a tree to make room for a new playground. After a trip to the rainforest and a meeting with Mother Nature, everyone learns the importance of taking care of our world. As Earth Day comes to an end, Barney reminds us all that taking good care of our Earth is the natural thing to dofor the people we love.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney helps Baby Bop see that winter can be a wonderful time for fun. Then, when she least expects itthe snow begins to fall! programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Riff decides to create a musical zoo when their zoo trip is postponed. Gathering instruments that sound like real animals, Riff gives Barney and his friends a zoo-mazing experience. When they return, a sailing ship awaits Baby Bop on the playset!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Melanie is sad because she misses her friend, Marisa who is visiting relatives in India. programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When some of the children invite Barney to join them for a race, BJ and Baby Bop decide hell need their help. programme.title: Barney and Friends

When he asks for a healthy snack, his friends are happy to oblige.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When Baby Bop becomes a little bossy playing with her friends, Barney teaches her that being bossy isn't a nice way to treat your friends. Riff and Baby Bop decide to have a sale in the park to raise money to buy BJ a brand-new scooter.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop is having a hard time finding a story she hasn't heard before. Barney and the dinos decide to tell her an old story with a new twist...by singing Little Red Riding Hood! He reminds the others to include the child by showing them that even Barney feels excluded sometimes. In the end, everyone is included for a day of fun!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop is sad because she lost her pet caterpillar, Monty. Barney and the others try to help her find it. Baby Bop is surprised to discover Monty inside a chrysalis. With Barney and the animals help, Rachel learns that the park is home to many. Rachel realizes the importance of nature and of keeping our earth clean!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ receives a letter from his pen pal in China revealing that his pen pal will be coming to visit. With the help of friends, BJ hurries to get the park ready. Cousin Riff is moving to town!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ is pretending to be a great detective and a case quickly comes his way when something nibbles on one of Baby Bops healthy snacks. programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Everyone loves Barney! When Ryan tries to be just like Barney, he has a hard time filling Barney's shoes. Ryan soon learns that he is special when he's just being himself! programme.title: Flavor on the Fly
programme.sub-title: "Vermont - Northern Pike, Backcountry Brook Trout, and Mushroom Foraging"
programme.desc: Welcome to Flavor on the Fly - In the first installment of our newest original series, Chef Ranga Perera trades the towering Rockies for the rolling hills in the Green Mountain State. Out of his element and on a mission to find inspiration for new dishes that embody both the spirit of Vermont and his Sri Lankan roots, - Ranga meets with a myriad of enthusiastic characters; each eager to share a small slice of the place they call home. Perch nuggets, sharp teeth, and hot peppers - see what lies in store for our host in the first-ever episode of “Flavor on the Fly.”

programme.title: Flavor on the Fly
programme.sub-title: "Maine - Striped Bass, Smallmouth, and Maine's Finest Softshell Lobster"
programme.desc: When it comes to the Northeast, Maine stands out as a unparalleled destination. With its rugged coastline, fresh seafood straight from the Atlantic, and charming small towns, there's no place quite like it. In this episode of Flavor on the Fly, Ranga digs deep into his Sri Lankan roots to come up with a seafood curry dish like none other. Inspired by time spent with good friends, fly fishing for both smallmouth and striped bass, and harvesting local shellfish, this tour through the Pine Tree State results in a one-of-a-kind dish that gives cooking with local ingredients a whole new meaning. Follow as we crack open the shell of one of the most intricate and diverse fisheries Ranga has ever explored.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: It’s been 60 years since AA was introduced to the shooting sports world. Since that day, an immeasurable number of AA hulls have hit the ground and countless shooters have stood center stage raising a trophy where millions of dollars have been won. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell. - GUESTS: Zach Keenbaum (Team Winchester) Desi Edmunds (Team Winchester) Kayla Wilgus (Team Winchester) Amy Cawley (Team Winchester) Anthony Matarese (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: For the first time in history, the World English Sporting Clays Championship was held in the United States at the incredible M&M Hunting Preserve owned by the Matarese family in New Jersey. Watch as Winchester’s best shooters vie for Gold as they compete against over 2,500 shooters and 17 countries. We’ll also join the Kids and Clays foundation in Florida as they host an event that will most certainly touch your soul.

programme.title: Black Cloud

programme.title: Black Cloud

programme.title: Black Cloud

programme.title: Black Cloud

programme.title: Black Cloud

programme.title: Black Cloud
programme.sub-title: "Hunting with a LEGEND | W.E. Phillips from the "Duck Men" Series | "
programme.desc: Last season, Black Cloud joined W.E. Phillips at his Duck Club in the Arkansas Timber. W.E. Phillips was one of the original "Duck Men" in the classic Duck Commander Duck Men series with the Robertson family. On this hunt, W.E. tells stories of the old times and shares some CRAZY duck hunting strategies.

programme.title: Storytellers

In this episode of Storytellers, we join Jennifer in the field for a hunt that offers a rare moment to slow down, reflect, and honor a life dedicated to protecting others.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. We are proud to continue to be a part of this incredible program, getting these heroes in the outdoors for the hunt of a lifetime.

programme.title: Huckberry Homes
programme.sub-title: "Explore An Austin Musician's Bohemian Bungalow | : Episode 1 | Scott Ballew "
programme.desc: "Here at Huckberry, we believe that style isn’t defined solely by what you wear — it’s personified in your morning rituals, your bookshelves and music library, the furniture you choose to spend your waking hours in, and the gear closet that powers your passions and pursuits. Style doesn’t end with your closet, it sparks to life there. - On Huckberry Homes, we’ll be tapping into the most inspiring members of the Huckberry community to offer an inside peek into how they’ve crafted the place they call home. We will showcase everything from cold plunges to vinyl listening rooms, home gyms and offices, and other tools that inspire creativity and high-performing lives. - For our first entry, we turned to Austin, Texas’ own Scott Ballew. Our good buddy, Scott, is a filmmaker and songwriter who owns a Bohemian bungalow in the heart of Austin’s first suburb. It’s a home now that serves as a creative incubator, gathering place, hideaway, recording studio -- and maybe, as a personal shrine of a man curated by the man himself."

programme.title: Huckberry Homes
programme.sub-title: "Inside MeatEater Founder's Montana Home & Gear Garage | Steven Rinella"
programme.desc: MeatEaterTV‬ Founder and CCO Steven Rinella has been in outdoor media for a long time, and an avid outdoorsman even longer. In this episode of Huckberry Homes, Rinella takes us into his ranch-style home nestled on the edge of wild Montana. There’s a spacious outdoor kitchen, a geared-out garage workshop, a wall of skulls, and a treasure trove of dino nuggets. Things might not always be feng shui, but that’s ok. Rinella ultimately likes his space to invoke positive memories of time spent with his wife and three kids. - “If I was going to give two pieces of life advice, it would be to never have a plan B, and to make a place in your garage to put sh*t overhead.”

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE

After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.desc: La cantina es el lugar de reunión favorito para este grupo de amigos. Allí comparten sus alegrías y ahogan sus penas.

programme.title: El Renacer de Dos Mojados
programme.desc: Con la ilusión de cruzar la frontera, un grupo de migrantes es traicionado por su propio coyote, miembro de una banda criminal que los secuestra y extorsiona. En silencio, se fragua la venganza mientras las víctimas planean dar vuelta la situación.

programme.title: Herencia Mal Repartida
programme.desc: Un hombre cegado por la ambición manda asesinar a su propio hermano. La familia se divide y estalla una contienda brutal, donde la lealtad se pone a prueba y la sed de poder alimenta una lucha sangrienta que dejará cicatrices por generaciones.

programme.title: Traición por una Carga
programme.desc: En un negocio tan sucio como el narcotráfico, la codicia conduce a la traición. La deslealtad tiene un precio muy alto, que sólo logra saldarse con el sacrificio de una vida.

programme.title: La Cantina

programme.title: La Muerte Persigue a Jesús Pérez 2: El Don del Poder

programme.title: El Águila Real
programme.desc: Un cargamento de cocaína pura será la maldición y perdición de un hombre tranquilo.

programme.title: Sucedió en Michoacán
programme.desc: Años atrás, José, el "As de Oro", fue asesinado frente a hijo y esposa Inés. Emilio engañó y Ramiro mató a la familia de Pablo, el hijo de José. Ahora, José y su amigo Pablo descubren la verdad y planean vengarse con ayuda de la madre de José.

programme.title: La Bazuca de un Valiente en Tierra Caliente
programme.desc: César ha cometido un error mortal. Por defender a su esposa, ha matado al hermano de Margarito, un hombre impulsivo y vengativo. César ha huido, mientras el Comandante y Margarito le respiran muy de cerca.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: The way to healing can take on different forms. Little 7-year-old Leonor, was suffering from a very rare cancer, and it was decided she needed an uplifting project to give her hope. What better medicine than an endearing song that was created from Lenore and her sister Dot's imagination and a ridiculously cute and famous dog named Doug the Pug? This episode of Hope is Here is about how a famous dog, creativity, and a group of caring individuals came together to give a little girl a world of hope to carry on. The path to healing can manifest in various ways. Meet Leonor, a resilient 7-year-old girl battling a highly uncommon form of cancer. Recognizing her need for inspiration and optimism, a heartwarming project was conceived. What could be more uplifting than a captivating melody born from the vivid imaginations of Leonor and her sister Dot, accompanied by the adorable and renowned Doug the Pug? In this episode of Hope is Here we witness the extraordinary convergence of a beloved canine, boundless creativity, and a compassionate community, all united to bestow upon a young girl a profound sense of hope for the future.

programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

El ayudante de rampa Jeremy está desesperado por ascender en los rangos, pero una novata podría arrojar una llave en sus planes, después de que la tripulación trabaja toda la noche para convertir el DC-4 en un tanque de gas volador.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

El ayudante de rampa Jeremy intenta adelantarse a la compañera de trabajo Audrey entrenando a un nuevo empleado de la India para reemplazarlo. Y cuando la recesión pisa los talones de Joe, intenta negociar un acuerdo de $ 7 millones.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

Depende del ingeniero Adam sacar a la tripulación del C-46 de un atasco en una pista de aterrizaje remota en menos 40. Y cuando el capitán Devan y el copiloto Scott encuentran la amenaza de la cizalladura del viento en el famoso Bear Rock.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: AJ y Candace se casan en el Castillo de Hielo. Un frustrado Chuck intenta que la Electra le pague. Mikey, desconcertado, intenta hornear un pastel para el cumpleaños de Joe. Y en Terranova, una fuga de combustible, un curso de supervivencia aleccionador y un trágico choque sacudieron a la tripulación de Turquía. Cuando los fuertes vientos brinden la ventana meteorológica tan esperada.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La tripulación de Turquía hace el salto crítico sobre el Atlántico Norte. Pero en el camino a Portugal, un equipo se ve obligado a regresar. Sin potencia en un motor y sin forma de mantener la altitud, deben regresar a Santa María, donde el aeropuerto está en alerta de emergencia completa. Y Mikey y Scott buscan una nueva rampie, mientras que las esperanzas de Jeremy se desploman aún más.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Las tripulaciones C-46 y DC-4 compiten contra el deshielo primaveral para volar equipos mineros a una pista de aterrizaje en un lago congelado. Jeremy intenta alcanzar a sus compañeros rampies Audrey y Wilf. Y en el último tramo a Turquía, Arnie y Justin se enfrentan a algunos volcanes serios y al intenso tráfico aéreo del Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

Él hace todo lo posible para asegurar una nueva carta, pero su rival también quiere volar el nuevo trabajo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
